messages:
Marta: quick heads-up — spotted inconsistent phrasing across recent PRs (examples, migration guide, and SDK snippets). starting a mini pass to align voice + param names. pinging folks who touched those files.
Devon: thanks, can you list concrete instances?
Marta: sure — main issues: 'model_id' vs 'model' in code samples; 'response' vs 'output' in microcopy; examples using both JS callback style and async/await inconsistently. linked a handful in the doc draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/phrase-bank-draft (private doc).
Lee: I can take the SDK snippets (js/py). want to standardize on async/await for examples and add a short note about callback compat.
Samir: I'll tackle the glossary entries and naming page. we should decide canonical surface names (model vs model_id, prompt vs input_prompt). recommend 'model' and 'prompt' for public-facing docs.
Marta: +1 to that recommendation. also propose a small "phrase bank" file in repo (docs/voice/phrase-bank.md) with preferred verbs, nouns, and sample sentences.
Devon: agree. for migration guides, we should include a deprecation table mapping old param names to new ones, and a small code diff example. e.g.
```
# before
client.generate({ model_id: 'redwood-1', prompt: '...' })
# after
client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: '...' })
```
Marta: nice — can we also add a script or lint rule that flags old param names in docs? helps prevent regressions.
Lee: I can add a simple regex check in the docs CI that warns on model_id, response_body, etc. will open a PR.
Samir: for glossary updates — I'll add entries: 'model' (public param), 'model variant' (internal), 'prompt' (user input), 'response' (raw LLM payload) vs 'generated text' (consumer-facing). keep definitions short.
Marta: also found several broken links in migration-guide -> sdk-migration page. docs-bot, can you run the link-checker job on that folder?
docs-bot: scheduled link-check run on docs/guide/migration in 5m. report will post to #docs when done. :robot_face:
Devon: once link-check completes, I'll batch-fix redirects and add canonical anchors. want to avoid changing header slugs too often.
Lee: opened draft PR #8427 for snippet normalization (js + python). includes tests and CI lint for style. cc @marta @samir.
Marta: thanks Lee — I'll review today and add phrase-bank entries to the PR.
Samir: one more thing — voice: prefer active voice, second person for quickstart, but neutral third-person for reference. adding a short "voice rules" section to phrase-bank doc.
Marta: love it. timeline: aim to land snippets + glossary + migration deprecations by end of week. small follow-up sync tomorrow if needed.
Devon: tagging this as docs-sprint item. I'll add tickets and assign to the PRs.
Marta: excellent. quick note for reviewers: prefer microcopy examples that are copy-paste runnable. tiny tweaks ok (rename var names to match examples).
Lee: got it. will ensure both JS/py examples run in our examples CI.
Marta: thanks everyone. if anything blocks, drop the PR link here and we'll triage. :thumbsup:
